review_evidence: Complete primary inventory covers 16 Lean files; 12 files contain 199 theorem/lemma/example/axiom declarations.
The source develops stable matching and the Gale-Shapley algorithm, including matching definitions, iteration, optimality, lattice results, Hwang results, and a computable implementation.
The three declaration-scan exceptions are root/import/build modules; the formal source tree otherwise forms one substantive development and no lossless exclusion was established.
summary: Retain the complete Gale-Shapley formalization unit.
